title: Retained native publication recovery data
$comment: Data grammar only. Export copies existing original files under the actual journal lock. Neither these pins, copied files nor schema validation authenticate a publication, complete Setup, unlock a held effect, or authorize a retry. Protected record-inclusion and finalization remain the only settlement consumers.

selection.description: Exact canonical ASCII selection <=4096 bytes. Activation/prepared pins come from actual protected lookup; journal identity/owner and initial-state pin come from original admitted C9/service assignment. These are navigation and consistency pins, never substitute signing authority.

handoff.description: Existing explicit settlement input, canonical whole document <=8 MiB. Exact retained claim and signed receipt, with state/receipt hash and preparation association checked by export. The exporter does not verify the signing authority. Import is data-only and cannot bypass protected cryptographic verification, current requester/approval association or audit delivery.
